errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines two separate categories from the x-axis, "Етерично-маслени и..." (Essential-oil and...) and "Фуражни култури" (Fodder crops), into a single category. The chart actually displays five distinct crop categories, not four as implied by the description.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва стойности, етикетирани като "площ, ха"
errors.evidence: The vertical axis itself does not have a label. The unit "площ, ха" (area, ha) is mentioned in the legend entries for each year, not as a direct label for the y-axis.
The phrase "and are marked with a number" is ambiguous. It is unclear what it refers to. While the years are numbers, the phrasing is confusing and does not add clarity.
